test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is __However__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The word however is an adverb.
 
• The word However is used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or appears to contradict something previously said.

Example : Meera is a good girl however she is annoying sometimes.

 
• An adverb is a word or phrase that odifies or qualifies an adjective, verb, other adverb, or a word group, expressing a relationship of place, time, circumstance, manner, cause, degree, and so on.

Example : very loud. tall, quickly

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• The word Thus is an adverb which means as a result.

*Example *: I am ill Thus I wont be able to attend class.

 
• The word Thereby is an adverb which means because of that.

*Example *: He signed the contract, thereby forfeiting his right to the property.

 
• The word Therefore is an adverb which means consequently.

*Example *: She is rich therefore she developed ego.
